rows.basis: NVD describes a crash in jabberd 1.4.3 and jadc2s 0.9.0 reached by malformed packets on an XML socket; the defect is in how those daemons drive expat, and no libexpat commit or release note fixes it. Nothing in libexpat source corresponds to the advisory.
NVD names Apache APR-util before 1.3.7 (xml/apr_xml.c); the fix is in APR-util, not libexpat, and R_2_6_2 contains no APR-util code.
NVD names neon before 0.28.6 when expat is used; the missing recursion detection is in neon's XML reader, and the fix is in neon. No libexpat change is associated.
NVD names expat_erl.c in ejabberd before 2.1.7 and exmpp before 0.9.7; the entity recursion check is in those Erlang bindings, not in libexpat.

The advisory covers Firefox < 50 using its bundled expat copy; Mozilla fixed it by taking expat 2.2.0, whose integer-overflow fix is present at R_2_6_2. The OSV record's fixed events are mozilla-central commits, not libexpat commits.
Debian catalog entry for the same Firefox < 50 advisory as disc2_cf66e163a2cb77010cecb502; it describes Mozilla's bundled expat, and R_2_6_2 contains expat 2.6.2, which postdates the 2.2.0 fix.

NVD describes CPython's _elementtree failing to call XML_SetHashSalt during module init; the fix is in CPython, and libexpat at R_2_6_2 does seed the salt itself when the caller does not (startParsing -> generate_hash_secret_salt).

NVD describes Apache OpenOffice up to 4.1.10 bundling expat before 2.1.0 and exposing CVE-2013-0340 entity expansion; the advice is to move to a newer expat. R_2_6_2 is far past 2.1.0 and already enforces entity-expansion limits.
NVD describes an out-of-bounds read in the Firefox RLBox Expat driver (Firefox < 113); the driver is Mozilla code, not libexpat source.
